status: measured Core output; exploratory, no acceptance gate

conditions.test_route: ArtifactCore::AutoColorMatcher ImageF32x4_RGBA overload; Core measurement emitted by the authorized Debug contract test

measurements.color_space: CIE Lab D65/2-degree computed from clamped display-sRGB values
measurements.deltaE76: mean, nearest-rank p95, max, and fraction above 2 ΔE76 per pixel, separately to unchanged source and constructed synthetic reference; 2 is descriptive only and not a quality threshold
measurements.Cstar: C*ab of ROI mean Lab vector and mean of per-pixel C*ab
measurements.hue: circular mean of output per-pixel Lab hue; low-chroma fabric hue is unstable and descriptive only
measurements.alpha: preservation checked by test against unchanged source alpha

interpretation_limits: same CC0 portrait was used to construct its reference with a fixed per-channel cast; not a photographic WB pair or physical target
face/arm/blouse ROI masks were analyst-reviewed before previous source-mirror scoring, not independently annotated
light blouse is patterned/shaded and not measured neutral white
2 ΔE76 exceedance is a descriptive reporting cutoff only; no quality threshold, blind review, or method winner assigned
no ICC/profile-aware conversion or app/render route/performance assessment
